title: The Fit Complaint
brief: A customer of Meridian Works writes that hinge pins from delivery lot {{lot}} do not fit their assemblies: 18 of 200 checked are oversize. They ask for a response within 48 hours. You have 12 visit points to limit the exposure, find the cause, and prepare the response.

actions.label: Other deliveries from the same production run
General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: Grinder operator: anything unusual during the run
A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Calibration record for air gauge AG-2
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: Complaint record CR-311 for lot {{lot}} was logged on the day it arrived, with the customer's data attached and an owner assigned.
evidence.whyItMatters: Customer feedback is captured and owned promptly.
evidence.falseFindingNote: The complaint was logged and owned on time. Conforming.

evidence.text: Lot {{lot}} was one of 3 deliveries from grinding run 88; the other 2 deliveries went to another customer last week. No hold or notice covers them.
evidence.whyItMatters: When output is found nonconforming, other output from the same conditions must be identified and controlled, including product already delivered.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask which other lots came from the same run. Containment follows the run, not just the complaint.

evidence.text: 28 boxes from lot {{lot}} remain in the store, marked "on hold" by hand on 3 of them only.
evidence.whyItMatters: Containment has started but is incomplete. Every box needs a clear hold status.
evidence.missedExplanation: Count the boxes and the hold labels.

evidence.text: In-process checks for run 88: the check sheet calls for one diameter reading every 30 minutes; there is a 3-hour gap on night shift with no readings.
evidence.whyItMatters: Monitoring at the planned stages is part of controlled production. A gap leaves output unchecked.
evidence.missedExplanation: Look for gaps in time on check sheets.

evidence.text: Operator: "The wheel dresser was down that night, so I ran on and planned to check later. There was no instruction on what to do." (note 7)
evidence.whyItMatters: Process conditions and what to do when equipment fails must be defined. Running on without instructions creates the risk seen here.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what happened during gaps in the records.

evidence.text: Air gauge AG-2 is in calibration, verified 6 weeks ago.
evidence.whyItMatters: The final gauge is valid, so oversize parts should have been detectable.
evidence.missedExplanation: Conforming evidence that points to sampling.

evidence.text: Final inspection sampling plan checks 5 pins per lot of 2,000 regardless of process events, and the record for lot {{lot}} shows 5 passed.
evidence.whyItMatters: Release verification must be suitable to detect nonconforming output. A fixed small sample with no trigger after a process upset is not.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask whether the sample would detect the problem that occurred.

evidence.text: Two earlier complaints on hinge pins (CR-240 and CR-277) were closed without linking them to grinding.
evidence.whyItMatters: Linking complaints helps find patterns. This is an opportunity to improve trend review.
evidence.missedExplanation: Search past complaints for the same part.

evidence.text: The complaint procedure sets a 48-hour first response with containment details. It is current and available.
evidence.whyItMatters: The organization has defined how to answer customers.
evidence.falseFindingNote: The procedure exists and is current. Conforming.

evidence.text: Delivery notes for lot {{lot}} list the grinding run number 88, which allows tracing.
evidence.whyItMatters: Traceability from delivery to run is maintained.

evidence.text: Stock rotation records show first-in, first-out was followed except for one urgent order that was picked from newer stock with a signed approval.
evidence.whyItMatters: An approved exception to rotation is controlled.
evidence.falseFindingNote: The exception was approved and recorded. Conforming.

evidence.text: Packaging is intact; boxes are labeled with part, lot, and quantity.
evidence.whyItMatters: Preservation and identification of the delivered product are in order.
evidence.falseFindingNote: The packaging is fine. The defect is dimensional, not handling.

decisions.prompt: What should the 48-hour response to the customer contain?
options: An apology and a credit note only
The containment in place (all of run 88, including the other customer's deliveries, held or under review), the immediate cause found so far, the corrective action plan with dates, and a contact
A statement that the parts passed final inspection
A request that the customer sorts all parts
decisions.rationale: A sound first response shows the customer that exposure is limited, states the facts known, and commits to corrective action with dates.

containment: Hold all stock from grinding run 88 and notify the other customer who received it
Offer replacement or sorting at the customer's site for lot {{lot}}
correction: Sort held pins at 100 percent with gauge AG-2 and rework or scrap oversize pins as authorized
cause: No defined reaction when the wheel dresser fails, and a fixed release sample with no trigger after a process upset
corrective: Define a reaction plan for equipment failure, including stopping and checking; add a tightened sample after any process interruption
effectiveness: Review the next ten grinding runs for complete check sheets and monitor hinge pin complaints for six months

debriefText.found: You limited exposure beyond the complaint and traced the cause to process control and release sampling.
debriefText.missed: Containment follows the production run, not just the reported lot. Ask what else was made under the same conditions.
debriefText.falseFinding: An approved stock rotation exception and good packaging are conforming.
